serving_geometry_basis: mmproj-free speech-feature-packet cells on build 04ccc72a. Worst-case per-slot window = 13,236 legacy registry text tokens + 468 measured packet speech tokens (the promotion receipt's own maximum) + 1,024 completion ceiling + 2 registered special tokens = 14,730; 3 slots x 22,016 = 66,048 total, a margin of 7,286 tokens per slot. The numbers are the POST-ROUNDING ones the server actually serves: llama-server rounds each slot's n_ctx up to a multiple of 512, so an earlier -c 65535 was reported back by GET /props as 22,016 tokens per slot, not 21,845. core.flight.FlightRuntime.serve derives -c as slot_tokens x slots from the adapter's serving_geometry(), so these three numbers must agree with the live server exactly or the flight is certified against a geometry nobody serves.
